    Gradings of modules by an abelian group #

    Used for the integer weights of Section 7: "a mesh weight w grades V_{m+1}(C) … and grades U_m(C) …; the map D_m preserves these gradings", and "Lift a basis of the integer ray weights to mesh weights … These give simultaneous gradings on the lifted modules. If μ has character χ, give ε weight −χ and choose the homogeneous solutions in the lemma."

    A grading MGr of an R-module by an abelian group M is a family of finitely supported orthogonal projections. A linear map shifts by γ if it sends weight g to weight g + γ; the weight-γ part of an arbitrary linear map is pr γ φ. Homogeneous solutions of linear equations are obtained by applying pr to arbitrary solutions, since pr commutes with composition by shifting maps (pr_comp_left, pr_comp_right).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.MGr (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (M : Type u_2) [DecidableEq M] (N : Type u_3) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] :
    Type (max u_2 u_3)

    A grading by M, by finitely supported orthogonal projections.

    • proj : M → N →ₗ[R] N
    • supp : Finset M
    • proj_proj (g h : M) (n : N) : (self.proj g) ((self.proj h) n) = if h = g then (self.proj h) n else 0
    • proj_out (g : M) : g ∉ self.supp → self.proj g = 0
    • sum (n : N) : n = ∑ g ∈ self.supp, (self.proj g) n
